entries.243960489f40e055: This is the largest business of the company group, engaged in manufacturing and sales as well as purchase and resale of cosmetic raw materials, wool grease derivatives, phospholipids, functional coating agents, resin additives, vegetable oils and fats, and synthetic resin products, as well as contract pharmacological and safety testing.
